test_objective: A Notification shall be sent (as mandated by each concrete binding and including any optional endpoint.info defined by clause 5.2.22) to the endpoint specified by the endpoint.uri member of the notification structure defined by clause 5.2.14

test_cases.name: 046_09_01 Check that a notification is sent to the endpoint
test_cases.doc: A Notification shall be sent (as mandated by each concrete binding and including any optional endpoint.info defined by clause 5.2.22) to the endpoint specified by the endpoint.uri member of the notification structure defined by clause 5.2.1
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}/attrs'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to 'airQualityLevel-fragment.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
